takeaway: Mean arterial pressure = [(2 x diastolic) + systolic]/3, because diastole is 2/3 of the cardiac cycle; 60 is needed to perfuse the coronary arteries, brain and kidneys, and the reference range is 70-100 mmHg.

layers.text: Pressure that perfuses the vital organs
